label: PF Backlog 546
title: C14: Security gates S0-S6 across the factory pipeline (intake->planning->impl->test->release->runtime->improve)
body:
## Problem / why
Security gates exist only partially (S2 secret/static scan, S4 pr_gate).
## Acceptance criteria
S0 identity/input; S1 threat-model/data-class/tool-perms; S2 dep/secret/code+scan+sandbox; S3 injection/jailbreak/authz/tool-abuse/leak tests; S4 security acceptance+artifact integrity+policy compliance+approvals; S5 monitoring/audit/anomaly/incident; S6 attack corpus+regression+policy update (review/versioned).
